title: Leading transcendental contribution to the four-loop universal anomalous dimension in N=4 SYM
claim: Direct component computation of the zeta(5) part of the planar four-loop twist-two universal anomalous dimension for the first three even moments, with a conjectured all-spin form; used to test the wrapping-corrected integrability predictions.
scheme: same component machinery as S1a.06 (dimensional reduction, Feynman gauge, IRR, Laporta/BAMBA, FORM); scheme statement not re-verified in this paper
symmetry_argument: none beyond the assumed SUSY of DR; the zeta(5) part is scheme-insensitive at this order (it cannot be generated by a finite coupling redefinition of lower orders, which have no zeta(5))

checked_partially: only the maximal-transcendentality zeta(5) coefficient computed, which is the least scheme-sensitive part

evidence: Abstract (paraphrased): direct component computation of the zeta(5) term for the first three even moments; general-spin proposal
red_flags: partial quantity (zeta(5) coefficient) - not a full four-loop result
lead in the task brief called 0811.0607 'non-planar'; it is the planar zeta(5) paper; the non-planar paper is 0902.4646 (S1a.13)
cross_checks: consistent with Bajnok-Janik-Lukowski four-loop twist-two with wrapping 0811.4448 (S1b record)
notes: Lead correction: 0811.0607 is planar/leading-transcendental, not non-planar.
